name: recoil_app_play_state_on_deactivate
description: RecoilApp_PlayState::OnDeactivate leaves gameplay state by restoring screensaver policy in accelerated mode, stopping CD audio and half-res mode, tearing down network or local audio UI state, running the MISSIONOVER FMV script, optionally shutting down mission gameplay systems, and unloading mounted ZRDR archives.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

The isolated smoke covers the network/skip-gameplay branch without driving full mission runtime teardown. The default mission-shutdown branch is covered by accepted HudSensorTracker::ShutdownMissionGameplaySystems functional evidence and Binary Ninja call-order evidence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x42f8e0 show HudUiLoadingCheckpoint::AdvanceAndLog("Leaving Play State"), an accelerated-mode SystemParametersInfoA(SPI_SETSCREENSAVERRUNNING, 0, ...), zSndCd::Stop, zVideo::SetHalfResAdjustMode(0), network-only "Leaving Networking" checkpoint plus HudUiNetExitPanel::DestroyGlobal, non-network-only "Stop All Sounds" checkpoint plus zSndPlayHandleSnapshot capture/stop, scoped zFMV_Script Init("fmv.zrd", "MISSIONOVER", 0), RunBlocking(1), g_RecoilApp.m_missionShutdownMode gate for HudSensorTracker::ShutdownMissionGameplaySystems, zUtil_ZRDR_UnloadMountedArchives(0), and zFMV_Script::Cleanup.

The dependency frontier for 0x42f8e0 has no visible source blockers. Direct callees are accepted functional dependencies; the remaining function reference is compiler-generated EH glue for the scoped zFMV_Script cleanup.

The native smoke verifies the network branch and skip-gameplay shutdown mode execute without mission runtime teardown, leaves the shutdown mode intact, keeps half-res mode disabled, and drains no mounted archives from an empty archive list. Existing accepted smokes cover the mission gameplay shutdown early guard and the no-action zFMV_Script RunBlocking behavior used by an absent MISSIONOVER definition.
